_comment: Fit controller: dataset, fit range, sampling and fitting controls. Replaces the hand-drawn fittingWidget.ui, whose controls were named spinBox_2..spinBox_6 and whose steps field was labelled 'Stps'. The four panels mirror its group boxes, so the controller's per-group show/hide (ProteinMC hides Fitting, keeping Sampling) still means what it meant.

sections.label: Dataset
sections.description: Which fit of this window the controls below act on.

buttons.description: Attach a different dataset to this fit.

sections.label: First
sections.description: First channel included in the fit.

sections.label: Last
sections.description: Last channel included in the fit.

sections.label: First (2)
sections.description: First channel of the second axis, for two-dimensional data.

sections.label: Last (2)
sections.description: Last channel of the second axis, for two-dimensional data.

buttons.label: auto
buttons.description: Choose the fit range from the data: the rising edge to where the signal reaches the background.

sections.label: Steps
sections.description: Steps per walker, in thousands. The diagnostics report whether it was enough.

sections.label: Runs
sections.description: Independent runs. Their disagreement is the R-hat that says whether the chain converged, so more than one is the point.

sections.label: Format
sections.description: How the chains are stored. Text reads anywhere; HDF5 is a compressed table about four times smaller, which is what a long run needs. Both open in nDXplorer.

buttons.label: Sample
buttons.description: Sample the posterior of the free parameters and write the chains, the diagnostics and the project to a folder.

sections.label: Result
sections.description: Which stored result of this fit is shown.

sections.label: Local first
sections.description: Optimise each dataset on its own before the global fit, which usually starts the global step much closer to the optimum.

buttons.label: Fit
buttons.description: Run the optimiser on the selected fit.
